name: Lionel's Barber Shop
tagline: Old-school cuts on Highland Drive, Aggie-run since 2005.
about: Lionel Garcia owns and runs this neighborhood barbershop on Highland Drive. The Battalion describes it as Aggie-run and operated since 2005.
Reviewers call Lionel an old-school barber, and they mention the conversation as much as the haircut.
hours_source: Hours as listed on the shop's public Birdeye/Google profile. Call or stop by to confirm before a holiday.

reviews.name: Joe
reviews.text: I love going to the barber shop enjoy the conversation and always a professional experience, thanks. Gig'em Aggies

reviews.name: Manuel
reviews.text: Lionel is an old-school top of the line barber!

sources: Address, weekly hours, 4.8 rating from 63 reviews, review quotes: https://reviews.birdeye.com/lionels-barber-shop-170237709069783

name: Neff's Majestic Hair Studio
tagline: Full-service hair studio on Wellborn Road. Walk-ins welcome.
about: Neff opened this studio on Wellborn Road in January 2020. It is a full-service salon for men, women and kids.
Walk-ins are welcome, and appointments are available if you need one.
hours_source: Weekday hours as listed on the studio's public Birdeye profile. Weekend hours were not listed.

reviews.text: Loved it!! I got a little trim with layers. He did great, my hair looks well blended and feels a lot lighter!

reviews.name: Joshua

name: Don Chente Mexican & Seafood
tagline: Birria, seafood and Mexican plates at two Bryan locations.
about: Don Chente opened in early 2021 and added a second Bryan location later that year, and it made its name with birria tacos.
Destination Bryan suggests pairing the birria with a michelada, and points to seafood like fish enchiladas and barbecue shrimp.

name: Hermanos Marquez Mexican Restaurant
tagline: Tex-Mex and big breakfast tacos on South College Avenue, open every morning at 7.
about: Hermanos Marquez is a longtime Bryan favorite with a new name. It used to be Mi Pueblito.
It's a family-owned spot for Tex-Mex, and it's busiest at breakfast, when you can build your breakfast tacos however you like.

name: Taqueria El Tio
tagline: Late-night tacos on North Bryan Avenue, open until 2 AM every day.

Destination Bryan rates its tortas, al pastor and fajita tacos among the most authentic in town.
